gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the default columns set for the issue navigator so that I can ensure the team is viewing the most relevant information when managing issues.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of the default columns currently configured for the issue navigator, including their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to update the default columns in the issue navigator to include 'Priority' and 'Assignee' so that my team can quickly assess the status and ownership of issues.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a payload with the new column configuration and return a success message confirming the update of the default columns.
